hypotheses.U1_pairwise_geometry_replicates: Independent invariant sketches have pairwise-similarity Pearson correlation at least 0.75.
hypotheses.U2_global_clusters_are_stable: At least one predeclared global partition has adjusted Rand index at least 0.50.
hypotheses.U3_local_neighborhoods_replicate: Median cross-sketch top-k-neighbor Jaccard is at least 0.25.
hypotheses.U4_local_motifs_cross_layers: At least one frozen mutual-neighbor motif contains heads from at least three layers.
hypotheses.U5_route_evidence_is_not_single_head: At least half of reported motifs have natural top-edge evidence contributed by at least two native heads.
hypotheses.U6_reader_evidence_is_concentrated: At least half of reported motifs have a downstream-reader effective support no greater than half their available native-head count times the per-head reader budget.
